crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Two high-contrast, roughly elliptical reddish-orange patches located on the lateral sides of the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Linear boundary separating the medium-grey crown from the darker charcoal-grey mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct alternating black and white transverse banding on the tail; prominent red circular feature at the base of the upper mandible.
